p: the priests: Who subscribed to keep the promise.
separated themselves from the people of: Who being idolaters forsook their wickedness and gave themselves to serve God.
clave to their brethren: They made the oath in the name of the whole multitude.
curse: To which they gave themselves if they broke the law, De 28:15.
that we would not buy it: Which nonetheless they broke soon after, Ne 13:15.
shewbread: This states why they gave this third part of the shekel which was beyond the half shekel that they were required to pay, Ex 30:13.
written in the law: This rehearsal shows that there was no part or ceremony in the Law, to which they did not bind themselves by covenant.
tillage: Wherever we laboured or worked, there the tithes were due to the Lord both by the law, and according to the oath and covenant that we made.
we will not forsake the house: We will not leave it destitute of that which is needed for it.
